title: Laser-cut box
summary: finger joints, compartments, kerf in the cut sheet
description: A finger-jointed plywood box sized from what goes in it or where it must fit, with compartments tabbed through the floor and a lid held by a frame, ready to laser cut with your sheet's real thickness and your laser's kerf.
process: Laser cutting of plywood sheet, glued or press-fitted finger joints

difficulty.rationale: Chained finger outlines, kerf offsets, tab-and-mortise grids and ranges coupled across lid style and sheet.

standards: Handbook of Finnish Plywood (2002), Table 3-1: birch plywood density 680 kg/m3
materials: Birch plywood sheet, 1.5 to 6 mm, about 680 kg/m3
